title: Monthly consolidated management reporting with commentary
prompt: Prepare monthly consolidated management reporting with income statement, balance sheet, cash flow and explanations of material changes.

setup.q: Which entities roll up to the parent, in what currency, and what eliminations apply?
Above what change (in reporting currency) does a line need an explanation?
Which KPIs appear on the front page and how is each defined?

inputs.name: Report packages and realtime statements per entity
Flux analysis for the period against the prior month

steps: the parent runs one child per entity in reportingStructure; each child pulls its income statement, balance sheet and cash flow for the month and the prior month
pull the consolidation run for the period and the elimination entries; tie the consolidated statements to the sum of the entities less eliminations
run the flux against the prior month; every line whose change exceeds commentaryThreshold gets an explanation from the transaction detail
compute the KPIs exactly as kpiDefinitions states and show the arithmetic
write the report package and the workbook; a report package version in Dime is proposed only when the requester asked for one

done.text: Consolidated total assets equal Dime's balance sheet for the parent as of the period end
Consolidated net income equals Dime's profit and loss for the parent for the period
Every exception row (a material change or an elimination that does not tie) cites the entity, the account id and the flux line
consolidated-management-report.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
Every entity in the structure appears in the workbook
Every change above the threshold has an explanation grounded in transaction detail; KPIs show their arithmetic; eliminations are listed, never netted into a line

tierRules.when: the requester asked for a new version of an existing report package and the statements tie
